prepared_by: AI assistant; labels selected by reading chunks.json, without querying the retriever
relevance_policy: Include every chunk that directly supports a factual part of the question's reference answer. Mere shared characters, words, setting, or a loosely related moral do not make a chunk relevant. Overlapping chunks can both be relevant if each contains supporting evidence.
scoring: Recall@k uses question and relevant_chunk_ids only. reference_answer and evidence aid label review; they are not an LLM judging rubric.
review_note: Evidence confirms that listed chunks contain support; it does not by itself prove that no other relevant chunk was omitted. Review against the complete 43-chunk collection.
